# Build Google Ads Account Query

Library pack: Google providers, authored 20 October 2026.

Build account identity or manager customer-client hierarchy queries. maxLevel bounds hierarchy depth. Accessible customer enumeration is a separate endpoint and lists direct OAuth access, not all descendants. Returned objects are limited to 3 MB UTF-8 to leave ONF transport headroom; reduce page/row/page-count bounds or use one-page reads if this limit is reached.

## Wiring
No data inputs.

- `request` (@ads.query): Request

## Configuration and effects
Pure builders/codecs never call a provider. Network nodes read Google data only; POST report/search is read-only. Choose the numeric property/customer explicitly. Configuration contains secret **names**, never token values. Default access-token mode requires a short-lived OAuth token in ONF Settings. Refresh-token mode reads client-ID, client-secret and refresh-token secrets and refreshes internally; no token is returned, logged or checkpointed. GA4 scope: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly`. Ads scope: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords`, an authorized developer token and account access; manager login-customer-id is separate. ONF LAN access does not grant Google access.

Network origin is fixed to the official HTTPS service; only an explicit HTTP loopback mock override is accepted. Redirects are rejected. Request timeout defaults to 15 s. Response bytes are bounded (8 MB default), reads retry 429/500/502/503/504 up to twice, honor Retry-After up to 30 s, and fail for longer waits so a schedule/durable timer can retry later. Authentication/permission/invalid requests are not retried. ONF worker cancellation kills the attempt; accepted remote reads consume provider quota and cannot be undone. Bound paging to the configured pages/rows; inspect complete and continuation before treating results as the whole dataset. OAuth refresh is attempted once per node attempt, not blindly retried. Sanitized failures omit provider bodies and credential values.

GA4 pagination is offset/limit; Ads Search has provider-fixed 10,000-row pages and nextPageToken, no pageSize. Integer metrics, Ads IDs and micros remain strings to prevent JavaScript precision loss. Reporting reads are safe to repeat but are not snapshot isolation and cost provider quota; no exactly-once promise.
